name: Isca Augusta
summary: Isca, variously specified as Isca Augusta or Isca Silurum, was the site of a Roman legionary fortress and settlement or vicus, the remains of which lie beneath parts of the present-day suburban town of Caerleon in the north of the city of Newport in South Wales. The site includes Caerleon Amphitheatre and is protected by Cadw.
aka: Caer Rufeinig Caerllion, Caerleon Legionary Fortress: Car Park and Garden of Endowed School, North of Broadway
